text:
jordan_support: ACME reporting 403s on project console after Okta rotated sessions this morning. They can list org but when opening project settings they get '403 permission denied'. Filing INC-1234. Can SSO/SCIM folks take a look?

alex_sre: On it. Do we have repro steps and which Okta groups/claims are mapped?

jordan_support: They say members of Okta group 'ACME_Admins' (we map to org_admin). Assertion includes `roles: ['org_admin']`. Okta told them sessions were rotated ~07:58 UTC. A few users can access, others get `403: user lacks project:view`.

mika_idp: I'm checking our SCIM and assertion logs. Not seeing mapping failures in SAML, but there's a spike in SCIM sync latency from 07:58–08:05. Could be backlog. @alex_sre can you check the authz mapper/invalidation worker?

alex_sre: Looking at cache invalidation queue — one of the mapping workers crashed (OOM) and left ~2k membership deltas unprocessed. I restarted the worker at 08:22; it started draining the backlog.

jordan_support: Customer says one user regained access after refresh, but 4 still 403. Screenshot shows the exact error: `403 Permission denied — missing project:read`

mika_idp: That fits a partial-apply scenario: group membership delta applied but project-level binding step failed for some entries. I'm re-enqueuing failed deltas and will add idempotent reapply endpoints.

deploy-bot: deploy: authz-mapper v1.4.3 promoted to canary at 2026-03-16T08:22:11Z by mika_idp

alex_sre: Patch is live on canary. Short-term workaround: ask affected users to logout/login or open an incognito window to force fresh session/token. Also check SSO session TTL.

jordan_support: Passed workaround to ACME. They tried incognito — 3 of 5 users recovered. Two still 403.

mika_idp: I'm running a manual reapply for the remaining two: `POST /internal/sync/user/3819/reapply` and `POST /internal/sync/user/3827/reapply` -> 200 OK on both. Can you confirm with the customer?

jordan_support: ACME confirms both users can now access their project settings. They want a root cause explanation and what we changed.

mika_idp: Root cause: Okta session rotation caused a burst of SCIM events; our authz-mapper worker hit an OOM and crashed, leaving a partial backlog. Some deltas applied out-of-order which caused missing project-level bindings for a subset of users. Fixes: increased worker memory, added durable queue and retry window for mapping deltas, added health alert for worker crash/queue length. Full durable-queue rollout ETA ~48h.

alex_sre: +1. Logging incident (INC-1234) and creating follow-up ENG runbook items. Assigned to eng-identity for postmortem.

jordan_support: Thanks everyone — shared summary with ACME and told them we'll publish a postmortem once ready. Closing support ticket after postmortem publish.
